title: pcapng-netflix-custom: eliminate or staticize routines.
description:
Eliminate wtap_block_get_nflx_custom_option() as it's not used.

Make pcapng_read_nflx_custom_block(),
pcapng_process_nflx_custom_option(), and
pcapng_write_nflx_custom_block() static, as they're not directly called
from outside this file, they're just registered in a table from here.
